chunks: Sama'ah asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام
about a man who is found slain in a village or between two villages. He said: "The distance between them is measured, and whichever of the two is closer to him is held liable."

key_terms.ضُمِّنَتْ: it is held liable or made responsible
key_terms.قَتِيلًا: a slain person or murder victim
key_terms.يُقَاسُ: it is measured; distance is assessed

ai.seo_question: How is liability determined if a murdered person is found between two villages in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for a murder victim found in or between settlements when responsibility is uncertain. The Imam عليه السلام states that proximity is to be measured, and the nearer village is assigned liability.
